strips.title: A first week with an Instant Pot — in real life

panels.head: Day 1 — the water test
panels.text: Three cups of water, sealing, pressure cook for five minutes, quick release. It proves the lid and ring work before food is at stake.

panels.head: Day 2 — first rice or beans
panels.text: Count on 5 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure before the timer starts. That is normal, not a fault.

panels.head: Week 1 — the burn notice
panels.text: Browned bits on the bottom or too little thin liquid. Deglaze, add water, reseal.

panels.head: Month 3 — the ring
panels.text: The silicone ring holds smells. Steam it with vinegar, and replace it every 12 to 18 months.
